name: kettlebell weighted russian twist
description: A seated twist holding a kettlebell. It builds the obliques and trunk rotation strength.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands at your chest.
Keep your back straight and rotate your torso to one side.
Touch the kettlebell lightly near the floor.
Rotate to the other side in a controlled way.
Keep your feet down or lifted if you can stay stable.
